metadata.question: Did water extent in Alsek Lake decrease between 1984 and 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Alsek Lake (Alaska/Canada border region, approximate coordinates: 59.4°N, 138.2°W) - Time periods: 1984 (Landsat 5) and 2010 (Landsat 5 or 7) - Collection: Use Landsat 5 for both years if possible, or Landsat 7 for 2010 - Need water detection method (NDWI, MNDWI, or water classification) 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using quality bands (pixel_qa or sr_cloud_qa) - Use water index (MNDWI or NDWI) to identify water pixels - Calculate total water extent for both years 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water extent calculated but shows zero/small area (legitimate result) - C1: No images found for one or both years - C2: Images exist but after cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values - Compare 1984 vs 2010 water extent: if 2010 < 1984, answer A (Yes, decreased), else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const alsekLake = ee.Geometry.Point([-138.2, 59.4]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around lake // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // 1984 - Landsat 5 let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(alsekLake) .filterDate('1984-06-01', '1984-09-30') // Summer months for best water detection .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1984 = await col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log("No data for 1984."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 2010 - Landsat 5 let col2010 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(alsekLake) .filterDate('2010-06-01', '2010-09-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size2010 = await col2010.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2010 Images (L5): ${size2010}`); // Fallback to Landsat 7 if no L5 data if (size2010 === 0) { col2010 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(alsekLake) .filterDate('2010-06-01', '2010-09-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); size2010 = await col2010.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2010 Images (L7): ${size2010}`); } if (size2010 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2010."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Cloud masking and MNDWI calculation function maskClouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).updateMask(saturationMask); } function addMNDWI(image) { const green = image.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } const img1984 = col1984.map(maskClouds).map(addMNDWI).median(); const img2010 = col2010.map(maskClouds).map(addMNDWI).median(); // Water mask: MNDWI > 0 const water1984 = img1984.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2010 = img2010.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // 4. Calculate water extent (pixel count) const stats1984 = await water1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: alsekLake, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2010 = await water2010.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: alsekLake, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1984 = stats1984.MNDWI; const waterPixels2010 = stats2010.MNDWI; console.log(`1984 Water pixels: ${waterPixels1984}`); console.log(`2010 Water pixels: ${waterPixels2010}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (waterPixels1984 === null || waterPixels1984 === undefined || waterPixels2010 === null || waterPixels2010 === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed (null result)."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (waterPixels1984 === 0 && waterPixels2010 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels detected in both years."); console.log("C2"); return; } const waterArea1984 = waterPixels1984 * 9; // 3000m scale = 9 km² per pixel const waterArea2010 = waterPixels2010 * 9; console.log(`1984 Water extent: ${waterArea1984.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2010 Water extent: ${waterArea2010.toFixed(2)} km²`); if (waterArea2010 < waterArea1984) { console.log("Water extent decreased between 1984 and 2010."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent did not decrease between 1984 and 2010."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
